$comment: D02 allowlist: the ONLY hosts a seed product image may come from.
Every entry is either the manufacturer's own domain or the CDN / headless-CMS
origin that the manufacturer's official product page itself loads its assets from
(Shopify for the brand's own store, Sanity/Storyblok/Contentful for the brand's CMS,
imgix/Cloudinary for the brand's own image pipeline, static.pub for Lenovo).
A retailer, marketplace, review site, stock-photo library or AI generator is NEVER allowed.
publish-seed-media.cjs refuses a file whose host is not here; ProductDatasetImporter
refuses a product whose media-manifest entry has a host that is not here.
licenseBasis values: official-site | open-icecat | distributor-pack | own-photo.

blockedHosts.cdnv2.tgdd.vn: The Gioi Di Dong / Dien May Xanh - a competing Vietnamese retailer. D02 forbids a competitor's photographs outright.
blockedHosts.images.unsplash.com: stock photography of a different product - the exact defect wave 0 exists to remove.
blockedHosts.res.cloudinary.com/*/gearvn*: retailer asset pipeline; only a brand-owned Cloudinary account is allowed.
